Package org.jdesktop.lg3d.displayserver.desktop2d

Class CompositedDesktopWiring

java.lang.Object
org.jdesktop.lg3d.displayserver.desktop2d.CompositedDesktopWiring
public final class CompositedDesktopWiring extends Object
The turnkey Phase G assembly that connects a live X11 compositor session to the conventional 2D desktop, so native X11 applications are hosted as ordinary MDI windows inside the 2D desktop.

It is the single place that knows how to build the whole object graph and register it: a Desktop2DCompositorHost controller (over a CompositedWindowHost that produces each window's Swing surface and a Desktop2DCompositorHost.WindowOpener that creates the Desktop2DWindows), wrapped in a CompositedWindowBridge and handed to a WindowLifecycleRegistrar so the window manager starts forwarding map/resize/retitle/activate/unmap into it.

Every collaborator is an interface or a plain Swing type, and the wiring is driven through an explicit Consumer<WindowLifecycleListener> registrar, so the whole assembly — including the decision to install at all — is unit-testable headlessly with fakes and a real (unrealized) JDesktopPane. The live glue that supplies the real host and registrar lives in Desktop2D, which reads the published X11CompositorSession.

  • Field Details

    • OPT_IN_PROPERTY

      public static final String OPT_IN_PROPERTY
      Opt-in system property that enables hosting native X11 clients inside the 2D desktop. Off by default so every existing 2D/Swing topology (which has no X compositor anyway) is unchanged.

  • Method Details

    • shouldInstall

      public static boolean shouldInstall(boolean optIn, boolean sessionLive, boolean headless)
      The pure install decision: host native X11 windows in the 2D desktop only when the operator opted in, a live compositor session was discovered, and we are not headless (there is no desktop pane to host into).
      Parameters:
      optIn - lg3d.x11.composite2d is set true
      sessionLive - a compositor session is published and active
      headless - the JVM is headless
      Returns:
      true if install(org.jdesktop.lg3d.displayserver.nativewindow.x11.CompositedWindowHost, org.jdesktop.lg3d.displayserver.desktop2d.Desktop2DCompositorHost.WindowOpener, java.util.function.Consumer<org.jdesktop.lg3d.displayserver.nativewindow.x11.WindowLifecycleListener>) should be called

    • desktopOpener

      public static Desktop2DCompositorHost.WindowOpener desktopOpener(JDesktopPane pane)
      The default Desktop2DCompositorHost.WindowOpener: creates a plain Desktop2DWindow for the composited surface and adds it to pane. Desktop2D supplies a richer opener (taskbar, workspace, cascading placement); this minimal one is what a standalone or test harness uses.
      Parameters:
      pane - the MDI desktop pane to add windows to
      Returns:
      an opener bound to pane
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if pane is null

    • install

      public static CompositedDesktopWiring.Handle install(CompositedWindowHost host, Desktop2DCompositorHost.WindowOpener opener, Consumer<WindowLifecycleListener> registrar)
      Assembles and registers the wiring.
      Parameters:
      host - produces the Swing surface for each redirected client
      opener - creates the Desktop2DWindow that embeds it
      registrar - installs the bridge as the WM lifecycle listener
      Returns:
      a live handle used to tear down
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if any argument is null
